in_sanskrit.name: Monirul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Protector of the Moon
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Monirul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Monirul is derived from the Sanskrit words 'moon' (mooni) and 'protector' (rul). This name is associated with the Hindu god Chandra, the deity of the moon. Monirul is believed to bring blessings of protection, tranquility, and prosperity.
